events.title: THE VOID NEBULA DEMO IS OUT (also update 0.15.0)
events.summary: Hello everyone, 0.15 is here.This update marks the closure of the open playtest. From now on, the demo will take his place and playtest is gonna be in private access only. (Come ask for it in the discord!)This update add the long awaited infinite mode and more QoL, as well as content and bug fixing.The demo contains Kali (and Ampyre when the Fest is gonna start) as well as 17 achievements and 2 difficulties per character. It’s a big demo yes, but still a tiny fraction of what the full game is go
